bio.en:
Teresa Soo is the co-founder of Shugaosha and the Australian Representative of the Japan Small Face Correction Certification Association.

After completing her advanced training in Japan, she became a certified trainer and went on to develop The Shugaosha Way — a precise, layered approach focused on restoring facial balance, alignment and harmony.

Through ongoing professional training and exchange in Japan, Teresa continues to refine and expand Shugaosha’s hands-on approach.

With years of hands-on experience and a commitment to continuous education, Teresa has treated over 2,000 faces while mentoring the next generation of practitioners.
bio.zh:
Teresa Soo是修顏社聯合創辦人，亦是日本小顏矯正認定協會澳洲代表。

完成日本進階專業培訓後，她取得認證導師資格，並進一步創立The Shugaosha Way——一套以精準而具層次的方式，著重重新調整面部平衡、對齊及和諧感的徒手方法。

透過持續赴日進行專業培訓及交流，Teresa不斷精進並拓展修顏社的徒手方式。

憑藉多年的徒手實踐經驗及對持續進修的堅持，Teresa至今已累積處理超過2,000張面孔的經驗，並致力培育新一代專業人員。

bio.en:
Charles Cho is the co-founder of Shugaosha and a certified specialist of the Japan Small Face Correction Certification Association.

Known for his calm and meticulous approach, he carefully adapts each session to the individual’s facial structure, supporting a more balanced, lifted, firmer and harmonious appearance.

With years of hands-on experience, Charles has treated over 1,000 faces while continuing to refine his skills and expertise.
bio.zh:
Charles Cho是修顏社聯合創辦人，亦是日本小顏矯正認定協會認證專家。

他以沉穩而細緻的方式，按照每位客人的面部結構調整每次Session，支持面部呈現得更平衡、提升、緊緻及和諧。

憑藉多年的徒手實踐經驗，Charles至今已累積處理超過1,000張面孔的經驗，並持續精進其專業技巧及知識。
